history.recommendation_text: 24. The Board recommends that the Administration analyse how the rules for travel and their implementation in Umoja can be aligned further, taking into account the need to clarify accountabilities.
history.reference_raw: A/72/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year; para. 316
history.administration_response: A comprehensive review of delegation of authority is being undertaken in the context of the Secretary-General’s management reform, with delegation directly to heads of entities across the Secretariat effective 1 January 2019. This review includes a review of the related areas in the Financial Regulations and Rules to clarify authorities and responsibilities for the exercise of financial authority, including certifying authority to be delegated to programme managers. The Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance sent an email to all entities that showed that Umoja travel roles were aligned with the new delegation. The Administration concurs with the need for further alignment of the rules for travel with the related accountabilities and their implementation in Umoja. A proposal to achieve this through an adjustment of the travel request process is being discussed among the relevant entities in order to work out the precise modalities.
history.board_assessment: The Board notes that the Administration’s response does not address the findings. The rules and their implementation in Umoja have not been revised. The recommendation remains under implementation.
